android-capi-http-client.description: Allow Android C API consumers to provide custom HTTP send/cancel callbacks.

android-curl-mbedtls.description: On Android, enable the native libcurl HTTP client and its mbedTLS backend instead of the default Java/JNI bridge. Can be combined with android-curl-openssl.

android-curl-openssl.description: On Android, enable the native libcurl HTTP client and its OpenSSL backend instead of the default Java/JNI bridge. Can be combined with android-curl-mbedtls.

curl-mbedtls.description: Add the mbedTLS backend to the Linux libcurl HTTP client alongside its required OpenSSL backend. Affects Linux only.

curl-openssl.description: Compatibility feature for the Linux libcurl OpenSSL backend, which is always included in the core package. Android uses the Java/JNI bridge unless an android-curl-* feature is selected, Windows uses WinHTTP by default, and Apple uses NSURLSession.

device-id.description: Collect a device ID using the SDK's platform-specific implementation (default). Omit this feature with default-features=false to supply your own DeviceInfo.Id without native device-ID collection.

no-exceptions.description: Compile the native SDK without C++ exception support. Does not change consumer or dependency compiler flags.

no-logging.description: Compile out internal SDK diagnostics without disabling telemetry event collection.

system-sqlite.description: Compatibility feature for the external vcpkg sqlite3 package, which is always included in the core package on every supported platform.

wininet.description: On Windows, explicitly use WinInet instead of the default WinHTTP transport for IE-integrated proxy or cookie behavior.
